Administration (SPF&MC) Department, dated.27.12.2022 and as per terms laid
down in Circular Memo No.4136/SPF & MC/2015-5, Dated.20.11.2017 and Circular
Memo No.4136/SPF & MC/2015-17, Dated.27.12.2022 of Government of Andhra
Pradesh shall obtain the Local Status Certificate from competent authority and produce
at the time of verification
8. The rule of reservation to local candidates is applicable as per the provisions of Andhra
Pradesh Public Employment (OLC & RDR) Order (Presidential Order)1975, and
amendments thereon shall be followed strictly.
9. Integrated Community Certificate issued by the Tashildhar (for candidates who have
claimed reservation under BC-A,B,C,D & E/SC(Group-I, II & III)/ST categories).
10. EWS Certificate issued by the Tashildhar who claimed reservation under EWS
Reservation.
11. PH Certificate issued by the Referral Hospital (if applicable)
12. RTI registration Certificate (if applicable).
13. Service Certificate issued by Competent Authorities of the Department of Defense,
GOI if applied under Ex-servicemen Quota
14. Experience Certificate (for the post of Principal, if applicable) as per the norms issued
in the notification

Important Information and Instructions:
15. Horizontal reservations (for Women, PBD, Meritorious Sports Persons, Ex-
Servicemen) will be implemented as per rules in force and relevant Government
Orders.
16. The purpose of this letter is solely to verify the particulars furnished in the online
application, which is a pre-requisite for consideration of candidature. Selection will be
subject to fulfillment of all prescribed conditions.
17. Candidates must produce all requisite original certificates on the date at the time of
verification without fail. Failure to attend or produce certificates will result in
cancellation of candidature for selection.
18. Candidates must upload the certificates in his/her MEGA DSC-2025 login before
attending the certificate verification venue.
19. Candidates must bring all original certificates/documents which are uploaded in the
online application along with three sets of xerox copies of the certificates/documents
duly attested by a Gazetted Officer.
20. Candidates should bring five recent passport-size photographs identical to the one
uploaded in the online application.
Note: The mere call letter is only for certificate verification and does not confer
any right of selection.
